response.overview: On a seemingly perfect industrial farm, every chicken lives according to the same routine—consuming the same food, obeying the same commands, and believing they are safe. Marked with an identification chip and confined to a tiny cage, Lina has never questioned the world around her until a mysterious white dove appears beyond the walls, awakening a longing for something she cannot yet understand. Guided by instinct rather than certainty, she begins to uncover the horrifying machinery hidden behind the illusion of order. Blending dystopian allegory with striking visual storytelling, La La Land explores the cost of conformity, the manipulation of truth, and the enduring power of individual courage. But if every generation is conditioned to obey before it is even born, can freedom ever truly survive?
response.tagline: What if the world you trust was built to keep you from questioning it?
response.title: La La Land
